newsitem.title: MEXICO: At least 17 die in Mexico City crash, blaze.
newsitem.headline: At least 17 die in Mexico City crash, blaze.

text.p: At least 17 people were killed and five others seriously injured on Tuesday in a multi-vehicle collision and explosion in Mexico City, the local Red Cross said.
"There were 17 bodies at the scene," a spokesman for the Red Cross said, adding that five more people had suffered serious burns.
He said a bus collided with a tanker truck carrying fuel which then exploded.
Several other vehicles ploughed into the crash site on the northern stretch of the city's Periferico highway near an exit to the central city of Queretaro, he added.
The cause of the crash was not immediately clear.
The Periferico is a six-lane highway designed for rapid transit but often choked with vehicles in this city of some 20 million people.
